svg.aria-label: Action button drawing sheet: plan of the touch size with trailing icon, radius details, size ladder, icon-only sizes, touch target detail, exploded layers, loading detail, states and variable tables
svg.text: LABEL SLOT HUGS ITS TEXT; WIDTH IS NEVER FIXED.
ICON SLOT IS OPTIONAL, LEADING OR TRAILING.
ICON SIDE TAKES S4 INSTEAD OF THE BASE PAD.
R1 IS A THEME TOKEN; RENDERED R = MIN(R1, H/2).
B IS ALWAYS 1; COLOR MAY BE TRANSPARENT.
NAVIGATION RENDERS A LINK STYLED BY THE SAME
VARIANTS; ACTIONS RENDER A BUTTON ELEMENT.
ICON-ONLY CONTROLS NEED AN ACCESSIBLE NAME.
Scale 2:1 · size=default · rendered R = min(R1, H/2)
Scale 2:1 · centers aligned · label slot schematic
Scale 2:1 · square · icon centered · V2 = (Z − I) / 2
Scale 2:1 · dense size inside a 44 target · hatched = hit area
Scale 2:1 · spinner in the lead slot
Scale 1.5:1 · trim to cap and baseline · V3 = (H − CAP) ÷ 2
States · same geometry, token changes only
Scale 1.5:1 · gray = state fill, not a color value
trim: no g j p q y
